info.name: ShopCart · Phase 1 verification
info.description: Verifies the Phase 1 delivery (database and backend) end to end: authentication with rotating refresh tokens, roles, ownership of data, catalogue and stock, cart limits, coupons, checkout with the 15 minute reservation, idempotency, order lifecycle and audit log. Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `newman`). Each run creates its own customer and catalogue, so it can be repeated; wait one minute between runs because sign-in is limited to five attempts per minute. See docs/api/postman/README.md.

item.name: 0 · Environment
item.description: The stack is up and the database answers.

exec: pm.test("the schema is up to date", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include("outdated"); });

item.name: 1 · Authentication (RF-01)
item.description: Phase 1 gate: registration, sign-in with a short lived access token, and rejection of bad credentials.

exec: pm.test("returns the new id", function () { pm.expect(json.idUser).to.be.a("number"); });
pm.test("the access token lives 15 minutes", function () { pm.expect(json.expiresIn).to.eql(900); });
pm.test("the account is a customer", function () { pm.expect(json.user.role).to.eql("Customer"); });
pm.test("no password or hash is returned", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/passwordHash|"password"/i); });
pm.test("it is the same account", function () { pm.expect(json.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newEmail")); });

item.name: Sign in with a wrong password

exec: pm.test("the answer does not say whether the account exists", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/not found|unknown/i); });

item.name: 2 · Roles (RF-01)
item.description: A customer cannot reach administration; the administrator can. The administrator password is in your local .env as SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

item.name: Customer asks for the user list

exec: if (!pm.variables.get("adminPassword")) { throw new Error("Set adminPassword to SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD from your .env (see docs/api/postman/README.md)"); }
pm.test("the account is an administrator", function () { pm.expect(json.user.role).to.eql("Administrator"); });

item.name: Administrator asks for the user list

exec: pm.test("the list is paged with a total", function () { pm.expect(json.total).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(json.items).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: 3 · Catalogue and stock (RF-02, RF-03)
item.description: The administrator builds a product and registers its stock; the ledger records it.

item.name: Register a stock entry of 5 units
A stock adjustment needs a reason
The ledger shows the entry with its balance

exec: pm.test("one movement, an entry of 5 with a resulting balance of 5", function () { const row = json.items[0]; pm.expect(json.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(row.quantity).to.eql(5); pm.expect(row.resultingBalance).to.eql(5); });
pm.test("the movement records who did it and when", function () { pm.expect(json.items[0].idUser).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(json.items[0].createdAt).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: The public store finds the product
4 · Cart (RF-04)
item.description: The cart refuses more than the available stock and totals exactly.

item.name: Ask for more than the stock

exec: pm.test("subtotal, discount and total are exact decimal strings", function () { pm.expect(json.subtotal).to.eql("200.00"); pm.expect(json.discount).to.eql("0.00"); pm.expect(json.total).to.eql("200.00"); });

item.name: 5 · Coupons (RF-05)
item.description: A coupon that cannot be applied is refused with its own code.

item.name: Create a coupon with a minimum of 500
Apply it to a cart of 200
6 · Checkout and idempotency (RF-06)
item.description: The reservation holds the stock for 15 minutes; repeating the confirmation creates no second order.

item.name: Start the payment: the stock is reserved for 15 minutes

exec: pm.test("the reservation expires in about 15 minutes", function () { const minutes = (new Date(json.expiresAt) - new Date()) / 60000; pm.expect(minutes).to.be.within(10, 16); });
pm.test("the order number has the year and six digits", function () { pm.expect(json.orderNumber).to.match(/^PED-\d{4}-\d{6}$/); });

item.name: Confirm again with the same key (double click)

exec: pm.test("it is the same order, not a second one", function () { pm.expect(json.idOrder).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("idOrder"))); });

item.name: 7 · Ownership of data (RF-01)
item.description: Another customer cannot see or touch this order: the answer is 404, as if it did not exist.

item.name: Sign in as the other customer

exec: if (!pm.variables.get("customerPassword")) { throw new Error("Set customerPassword to SEED_CUSTOMER_PASSWORD from your .env (see docs/api/postman/README.md)"); }

item.name: The other customer reads the order
The other customer reads its payment
The other customer tries to cancel it
8 · Order lifecycle, reports and audit log (RF-07, RF-08, RF-09)
item.description: Status history, a forbidden transition, cancellation, and the administrator reading the reports and the audit log.

item.name: The owner reads the order and its history

exec: pm.test("the order is waiting for payment", function () { pm.expect(json.statusName).to.eql("PendingPayment"); });

pm.test("the history records the new state and the date and time", function () { const h = json.history[0]; pm.expect(h.newStatusName).to.eql("PendingPayment"); pm.expect(h.createdAt).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: The history now keeps the previous state

exec: pm.test("two entries: created, then cancelled from the previous state", function () { pm.expect(json.history.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(json.history[1].idPreviousStatus).to.eql(1); pm.expect(json.history[1].newStatusName).to.eql("Cancelled"); });

item.name: The audit log says who changed the status

exec: pm.test("a status change with the user, the previous value and the new value", function () { const change = json.items.find(function (e) { return e.action === "StatusChange"; }); pm.expect(change).to.not.equal(undefined); pm.expect(change.idUser).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(change.previousValue).to.not.equal(null); pm.expect(change.newValue).to.not.equal(null); });

item.name: The stock is back in the store

exec: pm.test("the 5 units are available again", function () { pm.expect(json.variants[0].available).to.eql(5); });

item.name: The audit log of the products module

exec: pm.test("entries carry user, date, entity, action and values", function () { const e = json.items[0]; ["idUser", "createdAt", "entityName", "action"].forEach(function (k) { pm.expect(e).to.have.property(k); }); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("newValue"); });

item.name: 9 · Refresh token rotation (RF-01)
item.description: Each renewal returns a new refresh token; presenting an old one is treated as theft and closes the session. Run it last: it ends the customer session.

exec: pm.test("a new refresh token is issued", function () { pm.expect(json.refreshToken).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("refreshToken")); });

item.name: Present the old refresh token again
The renewed token is revoked too
